<!-- ==================== PROJECTS ==================== -->


::: {#projects .page-section}
## Projects

::: {.projects-grid}
::: {.project}
### [Adversarial Robustness of Neural Networks](https://github.com/kathrynblur/adversarial-robustness)

Started as my bachelor thesis, then became a tested Python package. Compares FGSM and PGD attacks, regularization, and adversarial training on logistic regression, CNNs, and ResNet-18. At ε = 0.15, adversarial training raised an MNIST CNN's accuracy under PGD from 19.7% to 88.6%. Includes a FastAPI service and a live Gradio demo.

[Python]{.chip} [PyTorch]{.chip} [FastAPI]{.chip} [Gradio]{.chip} [Docker]{.chip} [pytest]{.chip} [GitHub Actions]{.chip} [Weights & Biases]{.chip}

[Live demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/kathrynblur/adversarial-robustness)
:::

::: {.project}
### [PageRank on Academic Citation Graphs](https://github.com/kathrynblur/DataLab-PageRank)

Crawled 50 million papers and 531 million references from the Semantic Scholar API, with a live dashboard to monitor progress. Computed PageRank on the FAU Erlangen-Nuremberg supercomputer and compared a custom NumPy implementation with NetworkX.

[Python]{.chip} [PostgreSQL]{.chip} [Redis]{.chip} [FastAPI]{.chip} [graph-tool]{.chip} [Docker]{.chip} [SLURM]{.chip}
:::

::: {.project}
### [Explainable AI for Cardiovascular Risk Prediction](https://github.com/kathrynblur/xai-cardiovascular-risk-prediction)

Student research project. Trains classifiers to predict cardiovascular disease risk, then explains the predictions with SHAP, LIME, and counterfactual explanations.

[Python]{.chip} [scikit-learn]{.chip} [pandas]{.chip} [SHAP]{.chip} [LIME]{.chip}
:::

::: {.project}
### [Mushroom Edibility Classifier](https://github.com/kathrynblur/mushroom-predictor)

Compares machine learning models that predict whether a mushroom is poisonous or edible, on a Kaggle dataset with 54,035 instances and 9 features.

[Python]{.chip} [Jupyter]{.chip}
